content:
Rina: Uploaded a small-list variant for the API credentials page. Aim: denser rows for power users while preserving accessibility. Figma: https://figma.com/file/mini-list
Jon: Good start. Concern: action hit targets shrink. Keep interactive elements >=44px per WCAG mobile guidance.
Priya: Agree. Also the inline revoke button is visually similar to a link. Can we move it into the kebab menu or make it clearly destructive (red icon + confirm modal)?
Sam: About undo: backend has a draft endpoint but feature flag is off. If we show undo in copy, we must gate it behind the flag. aria-bot can confirm flag state?
aria-bot: Feature flag `ui_revoke_undo` = off in staging. Backend endpoint `POST /keys/{id}/undo` exists but rate-limited.
Rina: OK will make revoke copy conditional. Proposed safe copy when flag off: "Revoke this API key — this action cannot be undone. For rotation guidance, see docs."
Jon: For empty state with compact layout, prefer stronger CTA and clearer copy. Proposal: title "Create an API key" body "Start calling Redwood Inference. Use scoped permissions to limit access." Primary CTA: "Create API key" Secondary: "Key scopes & best practices"
Priya: Accessibility nits: 1) ensure modal traps focus and announces via aria-live; 2) permission pills need visible focus styles and aria-labels like "permission: read"; 3) verify with 200% text scaling.
Sam: Also keep created/last-used timestamps available — hide them in a details flyout rather than removing. Auditors need that data.
Rina: Action items: 1) update figma with 44px min row and invisible hit padding for actions, 2) conditional revoke copy based on `ui_revoke_undo`, 3) empty state copy update, 4) details flyout for timestamps, 5) add a11y checklist to PR template. I'll ping when done.
